positions.title: Software Engineer in Training
positions.description: Techtonica is six months of full-time, hands-on, project-based, collaborative software engineering learning with a focus on full-stack JavaScript. The last month is spent preparing to join Techtonica’s partner companies for employment.

positions.title: Student Staff & Peer Advisor
positions.description:
• Assisted in program and activities development aimed to support new engineering transfer students
• Provided peer mentoring through one to one advising sessions with new transfer students
• Track catering orders, keep a record of expenses, and process payment requisitions

positions.title: Student Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Respond to utility information requests from private and public agencies by providing GIS maps and compiling relevant as-built drawings and plumber notes.
  • Investigate and inform public agencies of potential project conflicts with planned water department projects
  • Managed and responded to emails and request sent into the general city distribution division inbox

positions.title: UCLA Summer Research Program in Beijing and Shanghai
positions.description:
• Conducted a ten week research project on the photocatalytic and adsorption capabilities of Graphene Oxide
• Compiled a final report of research findings and presented research poster at the end of the program 
• Participated in mandarin language classes and cultural immersion activities

company.name: Joint Research Institute in Science and Engineering by Peking University & UCLA

positions.title: UseIT Intern
positions.description:
The Undergraduate Studies in Earthquake Information Technology (UseIT) internship is a team based research program hosted by SCEC and sponsored by NSF Research Experience for Undergraduates (REU).

The program brings together students from different institutions and majors to take on the "Grand Challenge" posed by SCEC director Dr. Thomas Jordan. The Challenge changes every year but always involves computer programming and geo-science. Students are split into different work groups to take on the "Grand Challenge" in a multi-disciplinary and collaborative approach.

The Hazard and Risk Visualization Team(HarVi)
• Generated Shakemaps on OpenSHA of selected simulated earthquake scenarios
• Conducted Hazus reports on generated Shake maps to analyze potential building loss and casualties
• Installed shape files on ArcGIS to create spatial analysis of hazards and risk
• Developed GIS StoryMap to present our "Grand Challenge" research

positions.title: Undergraduate Reseacher
positions.locationName: August 16-24: Sailed on the Sikuliaq from Seattle, WA to Seward, AK
positions.description: STEMSeas provides undergraduate students from different backgrounds and majors an opportunity to board an NSF-funded research vessel to participate in  scientific research  techniques related to geo-science and oceanography. The program goals include exposing undergraduate students to geo-science as a major of study and to potentially collect seafloor samples to be analyzed and shared in global databases.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Processed a diverse selection of construction permits within the public right of way 
• Reviewed construction plans and provided comments to ensure plans were up to city standards and regulations
• Provided excellent customer service when assisting the general public with permit application process and answering of general permitting questions
• Created learning guides for new employees on how to process different permits and common problems associated with each permit
• Communicated and collaborated with different city agencies to advance multiple projects
